question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Disputable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Disputable"** means something that is open to question or debate; not certain. (विवादास्पद)

 
 
• **Example: **The theory he presented was highly disputable and many scientists criticized it.
 
 
 
• **"Indisputable"** refers to something that cannot be challenged or denied; certain. (अखंडनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The evidence provided by the prosecution was indisputable and led to a quick verdict.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Disputable' **is **'Indisputable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dubious **(संदिग्ध): Hesitating or doubting.

 
 
• **Example:** The claim made by the salesman was dubious and hard to believe.
 
 
 
• **Negotiable **(परिवर्तनीय ): Open to discussion or modification.
 
 
• **Example: **The terms of the contract are negotiable and can be adjusted based on your needs.
 
 
 
• **Salubrious** (स्वास्थ्यकर): Health-giving; healthy.
 
 
• **Example:** They moved to a more salubrious climate for the sake of their health.
